checks.what: Parse effective XML rosters by child node names and resolved patches; record positive animalDensity and complete fishable-to-living pairing. Existing validation.py is partial coverage, not proof of encounters.
Record declared current widths/cadences, scan/process intervals, sink flags and enum defaults; existing Kernel/RM_ChannelKernel.cs and SelfTest/TerminalBiomesFuzz.cs checks stay regression-only.
Audit field/terrain correspondence and actual ship reservation, dimensions, setting extrema, corrupt/partial grids and cycles; no live field silently lacks a readable bed.
Check all settings missing-value defaults, actual consumers, Scribe round-trip and composed-package registrations. Each deferred feature has an effective false default and no default availability.
Check native temperature, water, light, food and flight bindings against actual resolved defs, including growth temperature curves and industrial nonfood flags. No species-name sampling.
Check layer-specific weather bindings, no rain/thunder/water snow underwater, Scald margin nonpotability, no local sun fields; existing sea-floor text/no-rain scripts are partial regressions.
Check Scribe identity, holder contents, terminal sink arrival, rescue status and LightLedger restoration at each save boundary; mutation controls must fail.

Record count/time budgets for growth, population, current exposure, safe route availability and errors over full-map traces; tune against qualitative bars, never promote a numeric budget into refusal.
Audit declared hard dependencies and assembly/def references in composed packaging; About.xml standalone prose is historical and must not decide current world or load behaviour.

Retain review findings only after source confirmation: current map-ownership and sink-idempotence fixes, cadence due-time preservation, graze persistence and off-map Sunk recovery are already visible in source. Do not reopen them from old review prose.

rules.rule: Preserve one fixed world and the sea-floor layer; no new worldgen, surface settlement or hatch route. Ship reservations and its bank access are excluded from authored current and surge reach.

Current field is authoritative for carrying and siting exclusions. Terrain must show its boundary, but replacing terrain cannot secretly erase or create carry. A generated obstruction cannot leave a live downstream path through walls.

Use the existing ChannelKernel cadence comparisons: centre stronger than margin, surge stronger than calm, harness caps carry without immunity. Exact numeric cadences remain checks. Remove the legacy slow-registration option from supported default behaviour.

Default sink outcome is Recoverable. Sink arrival is terminal and idempotent; no source-map movement after transfer. Rescue requires leaving the dangerous liquid for safe shelter or safe carriage; a roof over the sink is insufficient. Never choose an unchecked fallback cell.

Take Direct Sun only from shared geometry into vanilla felt temperature. Steam/hot fog use ordinary air temperature, Scald contact is the shared liquid injury path; natives drink their environmental liquid. No local solar offset or steam health currency.

Separate Scald beach steam sky from calm submerged bubbles; salt snow is falling crystals, not water weather. The margin remains nonpotable. Material, terrain and layer determine exposure rather than a sea label alone.

Keep natural well lifecycle, gardener and gold glow; remove tenancy, graze pressure, event-dependent flora and culture dependencies. Use actual current membership for sites and the existing LightLedger for composed glow. Lifetime remains finite on the frozen sheet’s years scale; current short-lived values are tunable implementation debt.

Retain ordinary roster entries and their habitat/food/light needs. Shared native physiology and movement are not opt-in extras; no eviction or fictional flyer grounded by def omission. Ordinary static plant glow does not need charge/wilt behaviour.

Preserve defs and saved holders when switching features off. Gate dispatch, running jobs, availability and reload reassertion. Master/per-sea/per-major-feature settings explain effective state; existing cross-biome controls stay off and unsupported.

The campaign layer supplies peaceful inhabited bottom dwellings and placement lore without franchise references in RM. The gardener’s minimal tending is required by the lid, not a new encounter or town economy.

All kept dependency mechanics run together during evidence collection, at shipped defaults and with all DLC. Modelling changes neither the game’s population density nor its time order to obtain a pass.

meetings.why: Ship landing exclusion currently keys on a hatch, while later rulings remove the hatch; access/layer adapters are unavailable. Landing, bank reach and inhabitants must coexist.
Carry, harvest, site selection, sink/rescue and ship reservation touch the same cells. Straight spokes, crossings, walls and missed entry phases may destroy the safe operating region.
Transfer, hediffs, wells, off-state callbacks and holders can agree pairwise yet duplicate or strand an entity across a reload. Kernel serialization is not Scribe proof.

A gate removes behaviour/availability, never defs or the return route. Separate ordinary roster bodies from their attached extras; retained helpers consume no deferred products. This is an architectural argument, not a claim all current gates implement it.

Beach weather and submerged weather occupy separate maps; each floor uses its own material/lighting vocabulary. Quiet Grey life can coexist with crowded mineral forms. The shared group has no contrary spatial demand; B2 must still be seen.
Native growth, catch replacement, predation, water eligibility, harvest and moving light jointly set whether a floor stays alive. A season with every kept mechanism active has not been recorded here.
Well drift, current avoidance, native growth and campaign tending can leave no eligible replacement or an empty garden; external keeper implementation is not present here.
